skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding basic concepts of non-governmental organizations (NGOs)
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand fundamental knowledge about NGOs, their activities, and management by the state.
Analyze real-world problems faced by NGOs using management knowledge.
Demonstrate effective teamwork skills in group assignments.
Recognize different types of NGOs and their roles.
Critically analyze the operations and impact of NGOs.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing state management tools for NGOs
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Evaluate various tools and methods used by the state to manage NGOs.
Work independently and take responsibility for assigned tasks.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in work.
Adapt to changes and continuously learn new information.
